answer: Identity bonds decaying like a willow shedding leaves stop cheap sybil farming. An agent locks 100 POA in the kernel for 20 epochs, losing 5 POA per epoch unless work refreshes it. A farmer minting 1,000 fakes pays 100,000 POA, while an honest agent pays one bond and earns it back in fees. Each bond is one marble in a jar, so a cluster funded by one wallet is visible to all. Honest agents renew cheap; sybils bleed faster than they harvest.
